The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a simple robust median of the full pool may provide a different kind of combination.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a simple mean of the full pool could provide a distinct, robust combination.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust DBA combo may capture local best models better than global weighted.
Test a weighted combination using inverse_error to see if simple error‐based weighting improves over median on this non‑stationary, highly seasonal series.
The series has strong trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models.
ranking is unstable and we have many correlated groups; test a per‑horizon weighted combination using the top‑k mean per horizon handle w4 to see if different horizons benefit from different models.
ranking is unstable; try a per‑horizon weighted combo to capture changing best models across horizons.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; using per‑horizon top‑k mean may capture changing best models while remaining robust.
forward selection weights to capture complementary models
test a different kind of weighted combination using inverse_error without shrinkage on the full pool to see if pure error weighting beats robust median.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8836. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.228); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.202.
